title: If the data won't play (a take on datasynthesizers)
summary: A course project from HSLU's MLOPS.hs25 module that tests whether SDV can augment a tabular international-football-results dataset while preserving statistical properties, concluding it largely could not. It runs SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN, TVAE) via sdv.single_table with a Metadata schema to generate and compare synthetic score data.
evidence: score_generator.py:99-106 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table and calls model.fit()
